hooks.command: uv run --no-project python -c "import os, subprocess, sys; root = subprocess.run(['git', 'rev-parse', '--show-toplevel'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(); runner = root + '/.pskill/pskill.py'; arguments = ['uv', 'run', runner, 'hook', 'stop', '--harness', 'codex']; os.path.isfile(runner) and subprocess.call(arguments); sys.exit(0)"
